items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: And my mother was a domestic worker

ctx.x: And my mother was a domestic worker but he did this for me because, like all fathers would do, or some, showing their interest, you know. But I don't think it was two or three months later that he passed, but he was sick during that time, my mother told me. In later years she told me how it happened. And he died of tuberculosis.
Your grandfather, he had a really large family.
